Seafood is exceptional while watching the sunset of Ha Long Bay
Jul 2025 • Couples
After the Halong Bay day cruise tour, we visited this reputable place. I didn't make any reservations, but perhaps because it was a little early for dinner, I was given a corner seat with a view of Halong Bay on the top floor roof top when I wanted out, and it was just dusk, so I enjoyed the fantastic atmosphere.
You can order meals first at the reception desk on the ground floor, and there is an English menu so you can order without any problems. (The staff will kindly tell you if you have any questions.)
The food was, of course, delicious, but not special. However, the menu comes out quickly, and I think it's well worth visiting, including the atmosphere. If you visit Ha Long Bay, we highly recommend this visit.

Tasty dishes, beautiful space, and creative drinks 🍹🦐✨
Jul 2025 • Family
The food came out quickly, was super tasty, and the portions were generous.
The staff were friendly—some seemed a bit unsure, probably because they’re new.
The restaurant space is beautifully designed.

Highlights:
Tamarind mantis shrimp: rich flavor, firm meat – highly recommended.
Seafood spring rolls: not too impressive, I expected crispy fried rolls.
Seafood salad: refreshing and fun to eat.
Seafood glass noodles: very delicious but the portion was huge—we couldn’t finish it.
Grilled oysters with cheese and scallion oil: flavorful though the oysters weren’t that big.
Drinks: really good! Lots of creative options from the bar.
